_comment: PROPOSED — not active. To enable: copy the hooks block below into .claude/settings.json
(that path is gitignored here, which is why this proposal lives in tools/ where it can be
reviewed in a diff). Kept inert so a hook cannot start intercepting tool calls because a file
was committed; a guard the person did not choose is a guard they cannot trust.
Why: `claude -p --allowedTools ...` does not restrict the child session. See CLAUDE.md,
'Nested agents and harnesses', and tools/hooks/block_nested_agents.py for what happened.
The guard exits 0 (allow) for anything it cannot parse, and its behaviour in both directions
is pinned by tools/tests/test_block_nested_agents.py, which CI already runs.
After enabling, CHECK THAT IT FIRES before relying on it: ask a session to run
`claude -p hello` and confirm it is refused. $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR is the documented hook
variable for the project root, but it was not verified here (the hook is inert, so there
was nothing to observe) -- and an unverified claim about the environment is exactly what
this guard exists to prevent. If it does not fire, substitute the absolute path.
